video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Postgame Media Availability | 10-16-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the challenges of sitting out the game
quotes.excerpt: when it feels like it's just weight against you, you just got to go out and play.
quotes.quote: When you sit the whole game then try to go out there and play, it takes a little bit just to get going. When it feels like it's just weight against you, you just got to go out and play. You tend to overthink, which we've had a couple of those stints in preseason to talk through, so good reps even for those young guys going against a lot of talent on that other side there even at the end of the game.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the difficulty of staying ready after sitting out during preseason play: When you sit the whole game then try to go out there and play it takes a little bit just to get going. You tend to overthink.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Miles's versatility and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: He's super versatile. I think the number of ways that he impacts the game is high level.
quotes.quote: He's super versatile. I think the number of ways that he impacts the game is high level. Even in the first half when he didn't get a ton of shots, he's still able to impact the game and then the game just flows and he ends up impacting on the other end in the second half. So I thought his defensive intent was great.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praises the versatility of Miles: He is super versatile. I think the number of ways that he impacts the game is high level. Even in the first half when he did not get a ton of shots he was still able to impact the game.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Jaylen's ability to disrupt the defense
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen's ability to really get up into the ball at times really disrupted them.
quotes.quote: I thought Jaylen's ability to really get up into the ball at times really disrupted them. Jaylen didn't have to force anything and he still ended with 18 points in 23 minutes. We're trying to make the right play. I thought early in the game we got a little bit too deep into their paint and forced a couple things. We'll clean up some of the turnover piece, but overall how that group looks and feels, it feels right right now.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on Jaylen after an 18 point performance in 23 minutes: I thought Jaylens ability to really get up into the ball at times really disrupted them. Jaylen did not have to force anything.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the rotation and returning players
quotes.excerpt: We hope the other two guys are back, Luke and also are back opening night.
quotes.quote: We hope the other two guys are back, Luke and also are back opening night. Right now, we've tried to get close to a rotation there in the first half and early part of the third, knowing that hopefully we get Luke and also back so that changes it again. We're trying to bring Miles out, that's kind of been the thing that we've messed around with, Miles out to bring him back with the second unit. I like that at times, so again, it's so small sample size in the preseason.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott expects Luke and the other sidelined players to return for opening night. The team is still working on rotation patterns and managing Miles minutes as they prepare for the regular season.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on defensive off-ball movement and post defense
quotes.excerpt: We were a little worried about them posting us. I know it got us a couple times.
quotes.quote: It's just a different off-ball movement with their size and then their ability to take advantage of a mismatch. We were a little worried about them posting us. I know it got us a couple times, especially Jaren there, but I think overall pretty good. It's a different type of splits or off-ball action than what we saw the last two games against San Antonio and I think overall it was pretty good.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on defensive adjustments: It is just a different off ball movement with their size and their ability to take advantage of a mismatch. We were a little worried about them posting us.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Jordan's offensive rebounding instincts
quotes.excerpt: It's contagious, you can just feel it. His energy every time he's on the court.
quotes.quote: It's contagious, you can just feel it. His energy every time he's on the court. He's such a big piece of what we want to do and what we did last year, but even going forward, I think his offensive game has grown and he's able to add to both sides of the floor. He's just kind of a connector as a human off the floor. Every second he's around, whether he's on the bench or on the floor, we can feel his impact.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the energy Jordan brings to the floor: It is contagious. You can just feel it. His offensive game has grown and he is able to add to both sides of the floor. He is just kind of a connector.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on team identity and preseason growth
quotes.excerpt: When our rotation guys have played, we've played to our identity.
quotes.quote: I think we've seen it in spurts, in long spurts. When our rotation guys have played, we've played to our identity. We've taken some steps adding the new pieces, but you know, knowing until it's jumped up Wednesday night. We're in a good place. Health is always the first and foremost when you get through a preseason. I think we're in a pretty good place there and what we've been able to do on the floor with this group seems to be headed in that direction.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns are in a good place heading into the regular season: When our rotation guys have played we have played to our identity. We have taken some steps adding the new pieces.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on balancing health and team development
quotes.excerpt: We want to see growth. We want to see growth of this group take the next step.
quotes.quote: You want to have a little bit of grace with how it all comes together. I think we got to be mindful of that and our schedule's kind of broken up in a little bit different way to start the season with those first four games so spaced out. So we have to be mindful of we're going to practice and still continue to get better in those first couple weeks. But you want great health, but knowing that that may not always be the case. We want to see growth. We want to see growth of this group take the next step and it feels like we're right there.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the upcoming schedule: We have to be mindful of where we are going to practice and still continue to get better in those first couple weeks. We want to see growth of this group take the next step.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Jaylen and Book's defensive physicality
quotes.excerpt: When you have your best players play defense and then offensively play the right way, you got a chance.
quotes.quote: I thought, you know, when you ask them to do it and they're team, they feel what it does to impact our team. And when you have your best players play defense and then offensively play the right way, you got a chance. You got a chance every single night, and that's where we have. That's where it feels like we're headed in the right direction and we're ready to play because you got to see it happen and translate in the regular season because it doesn't end.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the defensive buy in from his stars: When you have your best players play defense and then offensively play the right way you got a chance. You got a chance every single night.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the new group's continuity and growth
quotes.excerpt: This is a new group with a lot of continuity. We want to continue to play the right way.
quotes.quote: It feels good. It feels good. Tonight we knew that they would they would play some of their their pieces and again we'll look at the film and we're going to continue to get better. This is a new group with a lot of continuity. We want to continue to play the right way and that's what we've done. But now we got to do it in the regular season. It's just different world in the regular season, but we've made it through the preseason, taken some steps, now we got to do it, translate it into the regular season.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the transition to the regular season: It is just a different world in the regular season but we have made it through the preseason, taken some steps, now we have to do it, translate it into the regular season.
